Respondents Coram : Hon'ble Mr. Justice N.S.Shekhawat
Present : Mr. J.S.Mehel, Advocate for  Mr. Paras Jagga, Advocate  for the petitioner.

Mr. D.S.Maan, DAG, Haryana assisted by  Mr. Abhishek Jorwal, IPS, DCP, HQ, Faridabad.
 *

1. The petitioner has filed the present petition under Section 482 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 with a prayer to grant anticipatory bail to him in case FIR No.639 dated 07.11.2024 registered under Sections 420, 120-B of IPC, 1860, at Police Station City Ballabhgarh, District Faridabad.

2. In compliance of order dated 30.01.2025, Mr. Abhishek Jorwal, IPS, DCP, Headquarter,
Faridabad is present in Court today.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in compliance of the order dated 30.01.2025 passed by this Court, the petitioner has joined the investigation.
4. Learned State counsel submits that Vijay Chauhan, main accused was arrested in the present case and the matter has been amicably resolved between the parties.
He further submits that the petitioner has joined the investigation and is no longer required for further investigation.
